tweets.text:
Teslascope V7 launches this weekend.

It includes a completely overhauled software tracking and analytics overview that provides more data than ever before.

+ Dedicated FSD Tracking

We shared a sneak peek with our X subscribers last week, and more to come in the coming days.

Tesla software update 2026.21.6 is now rolling out to ~13,860 additional vehicles within the last five minutes based on available fleet data.

This update includes Full Self-Driving V14.3.7 for eligible AI4 vehicles and V14.1 Lite for eligible HW3 vehicles.


Teslascope (@teslascope)

We noticed a new Tesla software update 2026.21.6 on Chuck's Cybertruck AWD in beautiful sunny, Florida. View the rollout of this update here: teslascope.com/software/2026…

On our @vehiclescope iOS and Android apps, we’re adding the much requested option to be notified upon a new software update being detected.

We've also begun initial testing with Apple Watch support and complications, with a scheduled release on TestFlight this weekend.

V7 is a collaborative effort made possible by hundreds of Tesla community members globally who have shared their feedback and feature requests with our team this year.

We remain committed to building the best experiences for all Tesla owners. Join us if you haven’t already! 👋
